description: The image is a photograph of a construction site, featuring an expansive area of bare, disturbed earth in the foreground. Two tall poles with rectangular yellow flags are erected in the midground, anchored by concrete bases. A dark utility pole stands to their right, and further right, a white sign with blue text is visible; text on the flags and the sign is unreadable due to distance and resolution. In the background, multiple multi-story buildings indicate an urban or peri-urban environment under a clear blue sky. This scene exemplifies a "Construction site" as defined under the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) CORINE Land Cover (CLC) classification for "Mineral extraction, dump and construction sites, land without current use" (class 1.3.1).
